2026-11-27.title: AI agents now control part of DeepMind's compute for Gemini experiments
2026-11-27.description: Google Deepmind uses AI agents to run experiments on their own for upcoming Gemini models. Research chief Koray Kavukcuoglu says the lab is still far from recursive self-improvement. For oversight, Deepmind intentionally leaves the agents' internal chains of thought untrained so they can be reviewed. Kavukcuoglu measures AGI by everyday user trust rather than benchmarks.

Based on our data, it looks like they’ve been tuned for cost savings. Specifically output tokens per task and reasoning tokens per task have dropped.

2026-11-24.description: Rockbox is a wonderful old custom firmware project for a variety of MP3 players and iPods.
